description: This file defines a PHP class 'SaveEmploymentStatusController' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Admin\Controller', which extends an abstract controller class to handle requests for saving or editing employment status within the OrangeHRM system. The class includes a preRender method that sets up a Vue.js component with properties based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveEmploymentStatusController
classes.description: Controller managing the save operation for employment status entities, determining the Vue component and whether it should be in edit mode or create mode based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes and sets up the Vue component for the view, selecting between 'employment-status-edit' and 'employment-status-save' based on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request.
